messages:
Priyanka (PM): Quick sync: Customer Q wants a clear launch acceptance checklist for the observability features before they enable Dedicated routing. Need a crisp definition of 'launch-ready'.
Mike (eng-runtime): Core engineering asks: tracing hooks for prefix/KV cache misses, and a lightweight per-request cost header so Console can attribute tokens. Also we should define sampling policy.
Sasha (eng-sre): Ops constraints: require canary SLOs and an alerting runbook. My suggestion: p99 < 300ms, p50 < 60ms and error-rate delta < 3x baseline over 5m for canary.
Ana (design): UX goal: single-pane landing that surfaces top routes by cost, a route-level cost delta compared to baseline, and a scrollable error-slice list. Will drop mock by COB.
Tim (eng-platform): Implementation note: adding a cost header touches the routing layer and event schema. Propose a two-phase release: (1) emit per-request token estimate in header (fast), (2) later enrich with actual GPU time from dataplane. Phase 1 unblockable.
Eva (customer-success): Customer Q requires embed calls broken out separately on the dashboard, and explicit language in UI that prompt contents are not retained or are scrubbed. Legal wants PII redaction from traces.
Priyanka (PM): Owners assigned: Mike -> tracing hooks + sampling policy; Tim -> cost header + schema migration; Ana -> dashboard mock + UX copy; Sasha -> SLO definitions + alert playbook; Eva -> CS/legal signoff.
Mike (eng-runtime): Sampling plan: default sample p=0.01, but always keep full traces for errored requests. We'll also capture cache-miss events as discrete metrics.
Sasha (eng-sre): Add a temporary canary anomaly detector: trigger if error-rate > 5x baseline sustained for 2 minutes, auto-notify on-call.
Priyanka (PM): Draft acceptance criteria: 1) Dashboard MVP shows per-route cost (tokens/estimates) and separate embeddings cost; 2) Tracing hooks live with sampling + always-capture-on-error; 3) Canary meets SLOs for 48 hours with no sustained anomalies; 4) Customer CS/legal signoff on PII handling.
Ana (design): Figma link: https://redwood.app/figma/obs-launch-check (internal only). Layout notes: filters in left rail, central heatmap for route cost, right-hand error slice list with drill-in.
Tim (eng-platform): Infra note: the header adds ~120B to requests, negligible at volume, but requires event-schema v3. I'll schedule a migration and keep compatibility for 14 days.
Mike (eng-runtime): Dev config example: ```json
{"trace_sampling": 0.01, "capture_on_error": true, "emit_cost_estimate": true}
```
Priyanka (PM): Blockers: schema migration timing, legal PII checklist, final mock approval, and metric name conventions.
Sasha (eng-sre): Proposed metric names: `redwood.obs.request_cost_per_route` and `redwood.obs.error_slice_count`. I'll add them to the ops playbook and dashboards.
Eva (customer-success): I'll confirm Customer Q's top-10 routes and provide a test payload set. They said they can start the canary in 10 days if perf looks stable.
Priyanka (PM): Risks: cost estimates might differ from final GPU billing  UI must label them as estimates; traces must be scrubbed prior to retention; dashboard cardinality could blow up without grouping controls.
Ana (design): We'll add a toggle: show estimates vs raw compute when available, plus grouping controls (by customer, model, route) to control cardinality.
Tim (eng-platform): Rollout plan: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%, automatic rollback on SLO breach. Flags: `obs_canary_pct`, `obs_cost_mode`. I'll create a canary ops dashboard.
Priyanka (PM): Timeline ask: customer wants minimal launch in 3 weeks. Thoughts?
Mike (eng-runtime): 3 weeks is aggressive but feasible with phase gating: week 1 tracing hooks + sampling; week 2 cost header + schema migration; week 3 dashboard + canary; allow a followup sprint for fixes.
Sasha (eng-sre): Ops needs a 48h validation window after canary before widening.
Eva (customer-success): I'll coordinate with the customer for canary dates and lock availability.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: obs-tracing-hooks -> staging (build #4529).
Priyanka (PM): Next steps: - Mike/Tim sync now to align header/schema changes - Ana deliver mocks by COB - Sasha draft SLO & runbook - Eva confirm customer test data. I'll circulate an acceptance checklist doc once mocks land. :thumbsup:
